difficulty_reason: Given a commutative triangle of schemes with f : X -> Y surjective and syntomic (resp. smooth, resp. etale) and p : X -> S syntomic (resp. smooth, resp. etale), the lemma concludes the same property for q : Y -> S (statement lines 4639-4655). The proof combines the three permanence statements of Morphisms with the chapter's own permanence lemma for flat finite presentation, which supplies the finiteness input that the Morphisms statements need (proof lines 4657-4662). The level is H3: the statement is a three-in-one permanence result and the proof identifies the finiteness ingredient that makes the three cited permanence lemmas applicable, rather than quoting a single ready-made statement.
